title: Dream Of Tasting Gasoline During Class At Mall
content: Had a dream where I was in one of the malls ive been in before and i was a part of some group class thing like I usually am. A huge woman was facilitating it, and our task was to drink gasoline. I cant remember if we siphoned it from cars inside the mall, or how, but we all were expected to drink or taste test about 10 different gasolines. Some were participating but I was getting mad. I started yelling out loud about how unsafe it is to drink gasoline and how stupid and pointless it is. Then i was in a different location from the second floor yelling at the people some more. I dont know what happens next but people were dispersing, i chased down a guy who was drinking the gasoline and i recognized him (he was a dishevelled, older version of a hard ass I knew in High school) and i told him he doesnt have to listen to those people about drinking gasoline. After i stopped him he grew enraged, ready to fight me. I told him i was just letting him know and then that was the end of that. He looked so awful up close. (side note:He also did get into fights in high school a lot but he was cool to me irl. The details of this mall are the same as a mall ive been in in reality, more or less. Theres two levels in this mall and i usually am on the second level. During the gasoline drinking, we were on ground level. When i chased down the guy, it felt like a part of the mall whered youd find the entrance and a bunch of other parts of the mall. This mall has maybe a few shops in it and is mostly dead space. Lots of dead space, which also is prevalent in my mall dreams too so the details in this dream are uncanny to irl. This mall seems to be the mall i visit in my school-esque dreams these days, i have other malls in mall dreams but for these group school type dreams I go to this mall instead. Mind you, school dreams are prevalent for me like Mall dreams, however they take place in school / auditorium dreams but the last handful ive had were in this mall. That is all i can recall on this dream. Dont drink / taste gasoline folks.
